findings.description: The codex lane returned verdicts that validate against the schema but do not match the pinned identity requirements: both attempts reported checker 'checker-second-opinion' (expected 'checker-courier') and model 'gpt-5' (expected 'gpt-5.6-terra').
findings.evidence: First attempt: {"task_id":"T-005","checker":"checker-second-opinion","vendor":"openai","model":"gpt-5","verdict":"pass",...}. Second attempt (retry): same checker and model names. Pinned requirements per lane spec: checker='checker-courier', model='gpt-5.6-terra'. Identity mismatch persisted across two attempts, blocking second-opinion completion.
